artifact.description: `capture`: write the btsnoop file; `--no-artifact` reports the counters only.

contains.description: Hex bytes a `notifications` call waits for.

enabled.description: `capture`: record packets from now on, or stop and drop what is held.

handle.description: Characteristic Value Handle, as a discover reported it.

indicate.description: Subscribe to indications rather than notifications.

label.description: `capture`: the artifact's file stem under ble/.

op.description: The GATT operation; the default is discover.

secrets.description: `capture`: record with the key material kept, for a pairing trace. Taints the instance, so `snapshot export` then needs the confirmation, and drops what the capture already holds.

settle_ms.description: `notifications`: let this much virtual time pass, then report what arrived.

text.description: The bytes as UTF-8 text instead of hex.

timeout_ms.description: Virtual time this call may spend before E_TIMEOUT.

wall_budget_ms.description: Host time this call may spend before E_WALL_BUDGET.

with_response.description: ATT_WRITE_REQ rather than ATT_WRITE_CMD; `--no-with-response` sends ATT_WRITE_CMD.
